CERTIFICATION 
(for Communication Expense) 
 
 
I, Caroline Laarni R. Sereñas, of the Office of the College and Board Secretary, hereby 
certify that: 
 
The communication expenses incurred during the period October 2026 in the amount of 
One Thousand Five Hundred Pesos (P1,500.00) were official in nature and necessary for 
the effective performance of my official duties and responsibilities. 
 
I have performed actual work for 20 days during the said period. 
 
I am claiming communication expenses in accordance with the prescribed rules and 
guidelines. 
 
This certification is being issued to support my claim for communication expenses for the 
month of October 2026. 
 
I hereby attest to the truth and accuracy of the foregoing statements. 
 
 
 
 
 
CAROLINE LAARNI R SEREÑAS. MPS 
College and Board Secretary 
 
 
 
CHRISTIE JEAN VILLANUEVA-GANIERA, Ed.D., CESE
